media_distribution: AMI media is not redistributed with MeetingToM. Users must obtain authorized access to the AMI Meeting Corpus separately and reconstruct benchmark media locally using the provided metadata and scripts.

state.description: Each STATE evaluation record reconstructs one independent 5-second clip of the target participant's close-up view with the corresponding meeting audio.
state.window_index_0: First 5 seconds of the original source window.
state.window_index_1: Last 5 seconds of the original source window.

you.description: Q1 uses the Corner view without audio. Q2 uses a 2x2 mosaic of Closeup1, Closeup2, Closeup3, and Closeup4 with Mix-Headset meeting audio.

consensus.description: Both questions use a 2x2 mosaic of Closeup1, Closeup2, Closeup3, and Closeup4 with Mix-Headset meeting audio.
